Give someone a mug. Its price doubles.
Same mug. Same classroom. Two very different prices.
Researchers gave coffee mugs to some students. The rest got nothing.
Then they asked. Owners, what would you sell it for?
Everyone else, what would you pay?
They had owned it for a few minutes.
That's why your old stuff feels worth more than anyone will pay.
Owning it was enough to double it.
